bio_draft: Luna Toke is the project of Goa-based producer and selector Sachin Shetty. He hosted Magic Tea on boxout.fm, a show of South American and African grooves mixed with house and techno, and released his debut EP 'Wandering' in 2017. His SoundCloud lists him as co-founder of the Tsunami Soup collective.

bio_sources.fact: Sachin Shetty, home studio in Goa

notes: Wild City Mix 054 (4 Apr 2013, https://www.thewildcity.com/mixes/3073-wild-city-054-sachin-shetty) is by Sachin Shetty, then based in Bombay, and names his space ambient project Antariksh and the techno project Clusters. Wild City's artist page treats Luna Toke and Sachin Shetty as the same person, which may explain the Antariksh Records link in the verify note, but I did not add Antariksh or Clusters as aliases because no page states it outright. 'Goa' is a region, not a city: the sources say Goa-based. kind 'selector' comes from his SoundCloud line 'Selector of eclectic sounds. Producer.' Instagram not found. The Facebook page facebook.com/pg/lunatoke is on Wild City.

bio_draft: MALFNKTION is the electronic project of Aditya Alamuru, a producer who came up in Bangalore's club and festival circuit and moved to Toronto in 2020. He released the EPs 'Hindustani Rascal' (2015) and 'Vote for Worms' (2016), then 'No Dough' on London's Exit Records in 2021, the first artist from India on the label. His music mixes hip-hop, bass and dubstep with Indian sounds and film samples.

bio_sources.fact: Aditya Alamuru; Bangalore club circuit; moved to Toronto the year before June 2021
Hindustani Rascal Sept 2015, Vote for Worms Dec 2016
No Dough on Exit Records, first artist from India on Exit

notes: He is listed as Bangalore-based before 2020; no page gives a home town, so from_city is null. The No Dough Bandcamp id is from the Wild City embed (album=3055960453), and the catalogue number is EXIT094 (RA). The Wild City artist page also lists RAAJA BEATS with Raka Ashok, the 'Lehrein' compilation (GRUV.COAST), the FOLKSOUL compilation with Krantinaari & Charu, and the single 'Infinity Trail'. I did not open these, so they are not in releases. Facebook: facebook.com/Malfnktion. No Instagram found. I found no mix URL I could confirm (the Wild City #135 page gives no embed).

bio_draft: Nishant Mittal, also known as Digging In India, is a New Delhi music archivist, DJ and record store owner. He hosted the monthly show The Home And The World on boxout.fm from 2018, playing records from India and abroad, and now hosts a show on NTS Radio. In 2025 he launched the label Digging In India Records for cassette and vinyl releases and reissues.

bio_sources.fact: aka Digging In India, New Delhi archivist and record store owner
The Home And The World, monthly boxout.fm show from Feb 2018

notes: Digging In India is both his alias and the name of his New Delhi record store and label, so Param should decide whether to merge it as an alias. He also runs mixcloud.com/digginginindia and youtube.com/@DiggingInIndia (on the NTS page). Our genre 'global club' does not fit: sources describe a crate-digger of Indian rock, funk, disco and Bollywood. As a label head, his releases are the label's, not his own, so releases is empty.

bio_draft: Oceantied is the alias of Bangalore producer and DJ Ketan Bahirat, active since 2014. He played the first Boiler Room session in India, hosted the monthly show Ripple on boxout.fm, and released the self-released footwork EP 'On The Floor Vol. 2' in 2019. He also co-founded the Bangalore collective Dasta in 2016 and plays guitar in Until We Last.
